versions.changelog: Keeps using an existing ~/.openclaw/youtube config folder until its files move to $OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR/youtube; an empty new folder no longer hides your config or sign-in.

New video command: the full description of one or more videos with their links and chapters, plus duration and view, like and comment counts (API key or sign-in, 1 quota unit per 50 videos). video and add also accept bare IDs that start with a hyphen.

Makes the skill fully analyzable by the security scanner: one ambiguous code comment reworded, and SKILL.md names files and hosts outside the skill so they are not mistaken for missing skill files. No behaviour change.
Commands in SKILL.md use the skill-folder placeholder again, with a note on replacing it per agent; this keeps the security scan from flagging every script reference. No behaviour change.
Keeps the security scan analysis complete: command placeholders use the PLAYLIST_ID style, and two error messages are reworded. No behaviour change.

Adds --json output on every command (one JSON document on stdout, Google reason codes in errors) and decodes HTML-escaped search titles. Works across agents: commands relative to the skill folder, install notes for OpenClaw, Claude Code and Codex, and a configurable config folder (YOUTUBE_SKILL_CONFIG_DIR). Clean errors for file, network and encoding problems.
Documentation only: rewords the last two SETUP.md steps that SkillSpector matched as session persistence; all config paths still documented. No behaviour change.
Documentation only: rewords two SETUP.md lines flagged as session persistence; all config paths still documented. No behaviour change.

Declares all capabilities: search works with just an API key, managing playlists needs a one-time Google OAuth sign-in (stored locally, refreshed, revoked by logout). Adds a permissions list scoped to the Google endpoints, the local callback, the skill config folder and the three env vars. No behaviour change.

Security hardening: delete and remove require --yes and preview exactly what would go without it; new logout command revokes the Google sign-in; documented permissions (network hosts, files) and narrower triggers; warns when config.json is readable by others.
First public release: YouTube search and playlist management (create, rename, delete, add and remove videos) via the YouTube Data API v3. Python standard library only.
